title: Classification of all non-split central extensions of naturally graded 2-filiform non-Lie Leibniz algebras
summary: This paper deals with the naturally graded 2-filiform non-Lie Leibniz algebras over the field of complex numbers. There are two finite series of such algebras, defined in every dimension starting from five, and two further algebras which occur only in dimension five. For each of these algebras we classify, up to isomorphism, all of its non-split central extensions, of every possible dimension. The one-dimensional central extensions are already known from an earlier work, so the main part of the paper is devoted to the extensions of dimension two and higher.
